name: @zettacore/aidrift-action
description: GitHub Action wrapper for AIDrift by ZettaCore checks.

scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run bundle
scripts.bundle: pnpm run clean && ncc build ../cli/dist/cli.js -o dist/cli --minify --target es2022 --license licenses.txt && ncc build src/main.ts -o dist --minify --target es2022 --license licenses.txt && node ../../scripts/finalize-action-bundle.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: vitest run --coverage.enabled true --coverage.provider v8 --coverage.include src/**/*.ts --coverage.exclude src/main.ts --coverage.thresholds.lines 85
